_about: SCHEMA DEMO ONLY — neutral placeholder entries. The real golden set (golden_set.json) is derived from an unpublished dissertation and is intentionally kept out of version control (see .gitignore). Copy this file to golden_set.json and fill it in for your own corpus.

retrieval[].question: a natural-language information need (paraphrase, NOT a verbatim sentence from the source)
retrieval[].target_paras: list of docx paragraph indices whose text answers the question; a retrieved chunk 'hits' if its [para_start, para_end] span covers any of these

traps[].question: a question about a topic GENUINELY ABSENT from the corpus; the grounded system must refuse

retrieval.question: Which method did the authors use to preprocess the raw input data?
What was the primary outcome and its reported effect size?
What theoretical framework does the discussion propose to unify the findings?

traps.question: What were the results of the technique X analysis the authors ran?
traps.note: technique X was never used in this corpus

traps.question: How did measurement Y change after the intervention?
What did the cohort Z subgroup analysis show?
traps.note: no cohort Z exists in this corpus
